import java.util.Scanner;

public class test {
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner scn = new Scanner(System.in);
        int n = Integer.parseInt(scn.nextLine());
        String ip = scn.nextLine();
        int wordCount = 0;
        int longestWord = 0;
        boolean insideBraces = false;
        StringBuilder sb = new StringBuilder();
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            char ch = ip.charAt(i);
            if (ch == '_' || ch == '(' || ch == ')') {
                int len = sb.length();
                if (len > 0) {
                    if (insideBraces) wordCount++;
                    else longestWord = Math.max(longestWord, len);
                }
                sb.setLength(0);
                if (ch == '(') insideBraces = true;
                if (ch == ')') insideBraces = false;
            } else if (Character.isLetter(ch)) {
                sb.append(ch);
            }
        }
        int len = sb.length();
        if (len > 0) {
            if (insideBraces) wordCount++;
            else longestWord = Math.max(longestWord, len);
        }
        System.out.println(longestWord + " " + wordCount);
    }
}
